brief.headline: LARVIK BOLIGBYGGELAG
brief.summary: LARVIK BOLIGBYGGELAG (organisation number 950553952) is a housing cooperative federation in utvikling og salg av byggeprosjekter (NACE 68.120), founded in 1946, with its registered business address in Larvik. On its verified website the company describes itself as: "LABO bygger og forvalter boliger i Larvik og omegn. Våre medlemmer har tilgang til boliger på forkjøprett og andre gode medlemsfordeler". Leadership on the register: Asle Frantsvåg Granerud (chief executive); Ingfrid Svendsen (chair of the board); 6 further board members; CEDRA NORGE AS as auditor. Scale: 39 employees (registered 2026-10-13); 3 registered workplaces in Larvik. In its filed accounts for 2025, the company reported revenue of 83.3 m NOK, an operating result of 9.3 m NOK and a net result of 9.5 m NOK; calculated from those figures, that is an operating margin of 11.2% and an equity ratio of 56%. Filed company revenue for 2025 was 83.3 m NOK; the change from the previous year is unknown because no company revenue in NOK was filed for the preceding year 2024-01-01/2024-12-31. Online, it has a verified website at https://www.labo.no/. It can be contacted by email at labo@labo.no and by phone on 33 13 85 00. No open roles were listed on its careers page when checked. This is the first observation of the company, so no changes are reported yet. Not established from permitted sources: company-owned social profiles, dated company-published activity and independent news coverage.
